readme: Every number has a basis: measured (local synthetic measurement or code constant), estimated (assumption, no real data) or proposed (target awaiting PM approval). Scenario user counts are planning cases, not forecasts.

scenarios.name: poc
scenarios.note: current learning PoC (T10 seed has 20 users)

scenarios.name: class
scenarios.note: one cohort of learners using it actively

scenarios.name: growth
scenarios.note: stress case to see what breaks first

behavior_events.note: about 10 tracked actions per active day; T71/T72 consent-gated events, no real traffic measured

audit_events.note: login, profile, document, consent changes; T83

auth_sessions.note: one refresh session per login, rows kept until purge (purge policy undecided)

user_skills.note: T147 factory uses 3; T34 users typically list more

document_avg_bytes.note: typical PDF resume; upload limit is 10 MiB (measured from code: document_validation.MAX_FILE_BYTES)

max_disk_utilization.note: plan disk so that projected data uses at most 70% (alert at 70%, critical at 85%)

new_postings_per_day.note: 6 seed keywords x about 33 new postings; live collection is HOLD (T61), fixture night run produced 28 postings

pages_per_posting.note: one detail page plus one list page shared by about 20 postings (T152 stores both)

html_bytes_per_page.note: no real page stored; synthetic fixture is 1,343 B; storage cap is 2,000,000 B (measured from code: raw_artifact_store.MAX_HTML_BYTES)

raw_retention_days.note: raw HTML is only for re-parsing; T152 retention not approved

companies.note: distinct employers seen in a year

company_postings_total.note: T126 company postings API is flag-off

requests_per_user_day.note: API calls per user per calendar day, averaged over all users

bytes_per_line.note: app.access line measured at 135-144 B (T112 format); Nginx proposed format line assumed about 260 B

retention_days.note: T112 proposal; access logs carry no query string

copies.note: T114 retention-plan defaults: 7 daily + 4 weekly + 3 monthly

calls_per_user_month.note: document analysis + Q&A; T110 (AI ops) NOT_STARTED, no real usage

usd_per_million_input.note: placeholder unit price, not a quote; model and contract undecided

usd_per_million_output.note: placeholder unit price, not a quote; model and contract undecided
